name: Bardo National Museum (Tunis)
scope: Standing Bardo National Museum exterior in Tunis: historic beylical palace, its garden arcade and the attached modern museum wing.
era: Existing museum following the 2012 opening of the extension. Historic building fabric is informed by the 2005 garden photograph and the heritage agency’s written description.

originalReview.notes: The photographer-dedicated 2005 garden view shows the pale historic façade, blue projecting timber windows and the public garden approach. Much of the historic building is behind vegetation.

review.method: Qualla media reviewed first, independently verified public-domain garden photo, named map outline and institutional descriptions
review.notes: Started with Qualla’s corpus. The published garden exit photographer’s credits template explicitly requests credit as a condition, so all of those photographs are excluded. The contemporary entrance and extension plan also lack unambiguous rights. The independently verified Anis Kochlef garden photo supports the blue bay windows and wall tones. The heritage institute and project archive document the portico and modern wing in writing.
